import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
py = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")

for command in [
    [py, "jobpipe.py", "scout", "--profile", "config/jobpipe.search.yaml", "--limit", "100"],
    [py, "jobpipe.py", "triage", "--profile", "config/jobpipe.search.yaml"],
]:
    run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=840)
    print("$", " ".join(command))
    print(run.stdout)
    print(run.stderr)
    if run.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
